copilot.userMessage: Can I take GrabCar or should I take MRT to stay within today's transit cap?
copilot.aiResponse: Taking MRT (Rp 14.000) keeps you within your Rp 50.000 limit with Rp 3.500 buffer remaining. GrabCar (~Rp 38.000) will exceed your daily cap by Rp 20.500.
